facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Scarecrow wanted a brain. Tin Man wanted a heart. Lion wanted courage. Her friends needed things.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy and her friends finally stood before the great Wizard. The Wizard's voice was loud and powerful in the big room. Each friend asked for what they believed they were missing. Her friends needed things they thought they did not have. Scarecrow wanted a brain, Tin Man wanted a heart. Lion wanted courage, and Dorothy just wanted to go home.
facts.Word cards: friends = 친구들 / needed = 필요했다 / Scarecrow = 허수아비 / courage = 용기
